claims.statement: The Republic described Tom Allen, the ex-champion heavy-weight of the world, as being in St. Louis in February 1887.
claims.excerpt: With the ex-champion heavy-weight of the world in our midst

claims.statement: Tom Allen was named with Tom Kelly as a teacher who could teach St. Louis youngsters boxing.
claims.excerpt: with Tom Allen and Tom Kelly to teach the youngsters the ropes

notes: The heavy-weight is read as Allen from the sentence context. Opening lines are garbled and name no fighter that can be confirmed as Allen.
